provided_toolkits.name: Wikis
provided_toolkits.description: Comprehensive wiki generation from GitHub repository analysis

code_toolkit.description: Code toolkit ID for accessing repository data

llm_model.description: LLM Model to use for text generation

embedding_model.description: Embedding model to use with embeddings

provided_tools.name: generate_wiki

query.description: Query or description of what wiki content to generate

planner_type.description: Structure planner to use: 'cluster' (default, deterministic graph-clustering planner) or 'deepagents' (agentic loop). Aliases 'agent'/'agentic' are accepted.

exclude_tests.description: When using the cluster planner, skip test files so they don't form their own wiki pages. Test nodes are still indexed and available to ask/deep_research.

provided_tools.description: Generate comprehensive wiki from repository analysis

provided_tools.name: ask

question.description: Question about the repository code or functionality

repo_identifier_override.description: Optional canonical repo identifier override (e.g., owner/repo:branch:commit8) to pin caches

analysis_key_override.description: Optional analysis key override (e.g., owner/repo:branch:commit8@wiki_version_id) to pin repository analysis to a wiki version

chat_history.description: Prior turns as [{role: 'user'|'assistant', content: str}]; the engine folds the last four into the retrieval question

context_paths.description: Wiki page ids the reader attached to this question, as published in the pinned version's manifest. Identifiers only: page content is resolved server-side from this wiki's own artifacts, and an id that is not published in that version is refused. Repository paths and URLs are not selectable.

context_wiki_version_id.description: The wiki version context_paths was selected in. Required whenever context_paths is given, so a question asked against the version on screen cannot silently resolve against a newer one.

provided_tools.description: Ask questions about the repository - requires wiki to be generated first

provided_tools.description: Deep research on a repository topic - uses multi-step analysis with planning, delegation, and comprehensive investigation. Requires wiki to be generated first.

wikis_toolkit.description: ID of an existing Wikis toolkit to connect to

llm_model.description: LLM Model to use for answering questions

provided_toolkits.name: wiki_query
provided_toolkits.description: Context7-style access to multiple Wikis knowledge bases. Discover available wikis, resolve repository queries automatically, and ask questions across different repositories. Perfect for AI agents that need to query multiple codebases without prior knowledge of which repository to use.

toolkit_config.description: Connect to the wiki registry to discover and query multiple wikis. Configure LLM and embedding models for intelligent repository resolution and question answering.

llm_model.description: LLM Model to use for repository resolution and answering questions

provided_tools.name: list_wikis

include_metadata.description: Include full metadata for each wiki (repository URL, creation date, etc.)

provided_tools.description: List all available wikis in the registry. Returns wiki IDs, repository names, and descriptions for discovery. Use this to understand what repositories have been indexed before asking questions.

provided_tools.name: resolve_and_ask

question.description: Question that may reference a repository. The system will automatically determine which wiki to query. Examples: 'How does elitea-sdk handle authentication?', 'What is the structure of the Pylon framework?'

wiki_id_hint.description: Optional wiki ID hint if you already know which wiki to query. Format: owner--repo--branch

provided_tools.description: Intelligently resolve which repository to query and answer the question. Uses LLM to match questions to available wikis based on repository names and descriptions. If wiki_id_hint is provided, skips resolution.

provided_tools.name: resolve_and_deep_research

question.description: Complex question requiring deep analysis. The system will automatically determine which wiki to query.

wiki_id_hint.description: Optional wiki ID hint if you already know which wiki to query. Format: owner--repo--branch

provided_tools.description: Resolve which repository to query and perform deep multi-step research. Use this for complex questions requiring analysis of code patterns, architecture, or cross-cutting concerns.

provided_tools.name: delete_wiki

wiki_id.description: Wiki ID to delete. Format: owner--repo--branch. Use list_wikis to see available wiki IDs.

provided_tools.description: Delete a wiki and all its associated artifacts. This removes all wiki pages, manifests, and cache files for the specified wiki, and removes it from the registry. This action cannot be undone.
